commands.command:
cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
[Unit]
Description=Inventory OS comparison worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
NoNewPrivileges=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
